signal: Kupsilla expanding its custom software, data engineering and AI integration services as a turnkey project shop.

email.body1:
Alexander, saw Kupsilla building out turnkey AI and data engineering teams for full project delivery.

Services shops like that usually have more in-market accounts than the team can chase before a project pipeline fills, and that is where revenue slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Kupsilla off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alexander, quick follow-up for Kupsilla.

When a consultancy scales delivery capacity, sales pressure jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to keep that bench utilized, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Kupsilla needs to cover the gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alexander, last bit of proof for Kupsilla.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kupsilla's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software shops. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alexander, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Project-driven businesses run in waves, and I know coverage is not always the fire of the week.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a services motion? I will tailor it to Kupsilla either way.
